basis: A pre-listing holding shown by the filing route: New Enterprise Associates V filed on Schedule 13G, not 13D and not as an institution (Item 3 unchecked), and its Amendment No. 1 of February 1997 means NEA V reported 5% or more by the end of 1995, 18 months after the July 1994 IPO. Under the pre-1998 rules that route was open only to a holder that acquired before registration or bought at most 2% a year, which cannot reach 5% in that time; NEA V (1990) held the stake before the listing. No round is named.

A pre-listing holding shown by the filing route: New Enterprise Associates IV filed on Schedule 13G (with ONSET, not as an institution), and its Amendment No. 3 of February 1997 means NEA IV first reported at the end of 1993, weeks after the November 1993 IPO. Under the pre-1998 rules that route was open only to a holder that acquired before registration or bought at most 2% a year, so NEA IV (1988) held Penederm before the listing. No round is named.
